items.reason: Five registered EXPERIMENTAL arms (dose escalation plus four expansion cohorts), none acting as a control; manual R8 reserves not_applicable for single-arm trials and gives 'no' for more than one arm with no control.

D31-C6: a PD objective is stated ('pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and the preliminary antitumor activity of TAS2940') but no PD measurement is described among the registered outcomes (MTD, ORR, DOR, DCR, PFS, plasma PK, safety).

note: Corrected D31-A6 resolved: the record states TAS2940 inhibits EGFR and HER2, so EGFR/HER2 aberration is candidate-matched. Under the clarified A2, 'EGFR and/or HER2' is one ERBB pathway, so the requirement stands. Still for XL: the primary outcome (candidate_matched_selection true) rests on a judgement that GBM patients are required to have the aberration; dose escalation requires it ('Any solid tumor with EGFR and / or HER2 aberration') and the GBM expansion arm is described as 'select solid tumors characterized by HER2 or EGFR aberrations', but 'Cohort C: Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma' does not restate it. target_engagement settled by D31-C6. Positive match goes to D21 review.
